name: Nami
description: Wano-era Nami uses the Zeus-imbued Sorcery Clima-Tact. Lightning is modeled as aimed projectiles; numbers and upgrades are gameplay adaptations. Forms, stamina, healing, actors, Impact Dial, Milky Road and Shower Tempo are omitted.

paths.name: Weatheria Forecasting
paths.description: Weather reading, positioning and mirage-aware targeting; stealth detection and retargeting are gameplay translations, not claims of omniscience.

upgrades.name: Charged Weather Balls
upgrades.description: Adds a denser weather-ball charge to every primary lightning impact.

upgrades.name: Rapid Pressure Cycling
upgrades.description: Shortens primary preparation through faster pressure changes in the Clima-Tact.

upgrades.name: Grand Line Rangefinding
upgrades.description: Extends aimed weather attacks for open-field and long-lane encounters.

upgrades.name: Mirage Tempo Reading
upgrades.description: Converts Nami's mirage awareness into detection against concealed targets.

upgrades.name: Calculated Retargeting
upgrades.description: Allows one lost primary target to be replaced at resolution without restarting windup.

paths.name: Clima-Tact Mastery
paths.description: Develops the Perfect and Sorcery Clima-Tact's wind, mist and lightning-control applications.

upgrades.name: Perfect Clima-Tact Dials
upgrades.description: Dials and Weatheria refinement increase the force of each primary impact.

upgrades.name: Gust Sword Venting
upgrades.description: Adds stronger wind projection, extending the effective weather attack reach.

upgrades.name: Thunder Breed Cloud
upgrades.description: A summoned thundercloud pulses around the primary impact and can briefly stun eligible targets.

upgrades.name: Thunder Lance Capacitors
upgrades.description: Stores a heavier lightning charge for stronger primary damage against durable targets.

upgrades.name: Thunder Lance Tempo
upgrades.description: A concentrated lightning contact can stun eligible weak-willed, stunnable targets.

paths.name: Zeus Model Conduction
paths.description: Uses Zeus's Wano-era presence in the Clima-Tact to intensify and guide destructive lightning.

upgrades.name: Zeus's Cloud Appetite
upgrades.description: Feeds Zeus larger lightning clouds, increasing primary damage; no separate hunger meter is modeled.

upgrades.name: Sentient Cloud Guidance
upgrades.description: Zeus helps steer summoned clouds into more reliable and forceful primary impacts.

upgrades.name: Raitei Conduction
upgrades.description: Adapts Raitei's overwhelming strike into a further multiplier against the locked primary target.

upgrades.name: Zeus Combat Shaping
upgrades.description: Zeus reshapes the weapon for faster combat handling, improving primary timing only.

upgrades.name: Raitei Discharge Line
upgrades.description: A successful lightning contact emits a separate line discharge away from Nami; it does not chain or trigger other effects.
